Messages.Author: Morgan Vening
Messages.Body:
Does Orlando Oriundus's special ability apply to within the Priscii
sub-referendum?

I understand that normal vote modifiers/action modifiers/special
abilities don't work. But 6.3.3 says "and no other votes may be used
in this subreferendum." But OO's ability doesn't refer to 'other
votes', but rather increases a vampire's innate ones.

Orlando Oriundus
Sabbat bishop: During a referendum, if Orlando is ready, your
vampires' votes are doubled when votes are tallied, and other
multipliers may not be played on your vampires. +1 bleed.

Morgan Vening

What you want is text like "even in the Prisci sub-referendum" (a la
Free States Rant).
